unpack_render_rgb: unpack uint32 ABGR pixel data into float32 RGB array with shape (H, W, 3) and values in [0, 1]
extract_depth_data: extract and normalize depth data for a camera, clamping values to [0, 1] with a given depth scale
get_segmentation_ids: extract segmentation object IDs for a camera, returning an (H, W) array with geom or mesh indices
get_camera_resolution: get the width and height resolution for a given camera index from the render context
test_render_util_functions: test the render utility functions for unpacking MuJoCo Warp render output with JAX arrays
